title: A Computationally Efficient Non-Interpolation Virtual Trellis Approach for Mammogram Gradient-based Patterns Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.34352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feature analysis is a crucial step in medical image analysis, particularly in breast cancer classification. Traditional image analysis methods often struggle with optimal patterns along the diagonal axis, computational efficiency and feature buffer storage. Different classical operators require high-efficiency hardware for the complex operations, such as image convolution and gradient analysis, which are used for processing complex machine learning models for training and test operations. Here, in this research, we introduce a non-interpolation virtual trellis-based (NVHT) operator that utilizes a filter kernel over the same square image without transformation to a hexagonal trellis. This proposed method is very efficient in reducing computational and storage costs. The proposed operator is used for improved feature extraction efficiency and accuracy in disease classification. This method outperforms conventional approaches by leveragi

translated_title: 一种用于乳腺X光片基于梯度模式分析的计算高效非插值虚拟网格方法
translated_abstract: 特征分析是医学图像分析中的关键步骤，尤其是在乳腺癌分类中。传统的图像分析方法通常在沿对角轴的最优模式、计算效率和特征缓冲存储方面存在困难。不同的经典算子需要高性能硬件来执行复杂的操作，例如图像卷积和梯度分析，而这些操作被用于复杂机器学习模型的训练和测试过程。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于非插值虚拟网格（NVHT）的算子，它在同一方形图像上使用滤波核，而无需转换为六边形网格。所提出的方法在降低计算和存储成本方面非常高效。该算子用于提高疾病分类中特征提取的效率和准确性。该方法通过利用……优于传统方法。
tldr: 本研究提出一种非插值虚拟网格（NVHT）算子，无需将方形图像转换为六边形网格即可直接进行梯度滤波分析，大幅降低计算与存储成本，并提升乳腺癌分类中特征提取的效率与准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a non-interpolation virtual trellis (NVHT) operator that performs gradient-based pattern analysis directly on square mammogram images without hexagonal transformation, significantly reducing computational and storage costs while improving feature extraction efficiency and accuracy for breast cancer classification.
